description: Each case is a GROUP of real-world listings of the SAME physical product, worded differently across dispensaries (naming, size notation, ALLCAPS, format words). After enrichment every member must land on the SAME identity tuple (the fields in expect_same), and match `canonical` if given. Brand is held constant so this isolates what enrichment controls (category, subtype, strain, variant). This is the cross-dispensary 'same product → same key' test.

cases.note: REAL listings of ONE product (Ruby Farms 'Night Cap' Elderberry Sage live-resin gummies, 20pk, 100mg THC) pulled from 7 dispensary scrapes. Enrichment split them apart because: (1) cannabinoid ratios leak into strain ('Elderberry Sage 1:2:3 THC:CBD:CBN'), (2) the product line leaks into strain ('Night Cap Elderberry Sage'), (3) the line spelling varies (Night Cap / Nightcap / missing), (4) one used physical weight (3.9g) instead of total THC mg. NOTE: product_line convergence on the canonical 'Night Cap' depends on the brand-examples nudge, which run_eval.py currently disables (brand_examples={}); strain/variant/category/subtype are model-fixable here.
